title: Concept: Machine-level sources stay active beside the repository list
description: nuget.config declares a nuget.config whose `<packageSources>` block never clears inherited sources, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a nuget.config whose `<packageSources>` block never clears inherited sources.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a nuget.config whose `<packageSources>` block never clears inherited sources.
